YEAR(dbo.Games.Date) = 2011 AND dbo.Files.HomeTeamID=47
SELECT dbo.Events.ValueStart, dbo.Events.ValueEnd, COUNT(dbo.Events.ValueStart) AS Frequency FROM (dbo.Events INNER JOIN dbo.Games ON dbo.Events.GameID = dbo.Games.ID) INNER JOIN dbo.Files ON dbo.Games.FileID=dbo.Files.ID WHERE (YEAR(dbo.Games.Date) = 2011 AND dbo.Files.HomeTeamID=47) GROUP BY dbo.Events.ValueStart, dbo.Events.ValueEnd ORDER BY dbo.Events.ValueStart, dbo.Events.ValueEnd
